description: Advisory only — compares a voice agent's current instructions against anchors/original intent/recent call summaries you supply and suggests up to 3 patches. Requires the OWNER or ADMIN role. Nothing is written; pass a suggestion's suggestedPatch to apply_voice_instruction_gap to actually apply it.

agentId.description: ID of the voice agent (from list_voice_agents)

anchors.description: Specific requirements the instructions must cover. Defaults to empty.

conversationSummaries.description: Recent call summaries, to ground suggestions in what actually came up. Defaults to empty.

originalPrompt.description: The original generation prompt, for context.

name: analyze_voice_instruction_gaps

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Analyze Voice Instruction Gaps
